about: Strings for Jingle Bells' Kiểu 1 (version 2a), written by Composer's Assistant 2 hearing the piano (its tune an octave up, its pulse and deep bass), as the user asked ("thêm lớp nền"): a bed from the first verse to the last chord (bars 0-64), in place of pulse's own strings in the last refrain. The violas (two notes at a time at most) and the cellos (one) throughout, the violins (one) in the last verse, each under the tune (loosely: lay_in keeps what the model wrote); notes starting about twice a bar (horiz 1), the cellos less (horiz 0), the upper strings mostly by step (step 4).
